{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "Jet fire",
      "name": "Jet fire",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The report describes a blowout followed by immediate ignition of a pressurized hydrocarbon release: \"Very quickly after the mud started spraying out of the well, the diesel oil-based mud and gas escaping the well caught on fire.\" It further states the event was a \"blowout and rig fire,\" and that the fire was \"massive and intense, engulfing much of the rig floor and the driller's cabin.\"",
      "explanation": "Within the provided consequence categories, the main hazardous phenomenon is a sustained fire from a pressurized gas/mud release at the well after loss of well control. The report's central analysis is the blowout development, missed influx indications, and failure to shut in the well before ignition, which most closely corresponds to a jet fire rather than an explosion or a brief flash event.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "diesel oil-based mud and gas",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "the diesel oil-based mud and gas escaping the well caught on fire",
      "explanation": "The blowout release that ignited consisted of flammable gas and diesel oil-based drilling mud escaping from the well.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "open well hole on the rig floor",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "open well hole on the rig floor",
      "explanation": "The uncontrolled release emerged from the well opening at the rig floor, where the blowout and immediate fire developed.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "TwoPhase",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the diesel oil-based mud and gas escaping the well caught on fire",
      "explanation": "The released material included both gas and liquid oil-based mud, indicating a two-phase release.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "High pressure",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the pressure on the well side of the orbit valve was previously so high that the trip tank pumps had deadheaded",
      "explanation": "Elevated well pressure existed before the blowout and provided the driving force for the forceful release from the well.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "High temperature",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the fire was massive and intense",
      "explanation": "Once ignition occurred, the scenario involved intense fire exposure and high thermal energy.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Combustible",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "caught on fire",
      "explanation": "The released gas and oil-based mud were capable of burning once ignited.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Continuous release",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "The BOP did not seal the well to stop the blowout",
      "explanation": "The release was sustained as an ongoing blowout rather than a single instantaneous discharge.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Low confinement",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "open well hole on the rig floor",
      "explanation": "The release occurred at an open rig-floor location rather than inside a confined enclosure.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Not dispersed",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "occurred within seconds after the mud started erupting onto the rig floor",
      "explanation": "Ignition followed almost immediately after the release began, indicating little time for a separate dispersed vapor cloud to form before burning.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Gas influx into the wellbore",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "gas began entering the wellbore",
      "explanation": "The accident sequence began when gas entered the underbalanced well, initiating the loss-of-well-control progression that led to the blowout.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "MechanicalFailure",
      "name": "Fire-damaged BOP hydraulic control hoses leaked hydraulic fluid",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "the control hoses that supplied hydraulic fluid to the BOP to function the rams had burned in the fire and leaked the hydraulic control fluid",
      "explanation": "Fire damage to the BOP hydraulic control hoses prevented effective BOP closure, allowing the blowout and jet fire to continue.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "IgnitionSource",
      "name": "Unknown ignition source",
      "node_id": "Ev3",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "the diesel oil-based mud and gas escaping the well caught on fire",
      "explanation": "The report clearly states that ignition occurred, but it does not identify the specific ignition source.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
